import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"plugins/sudoers/regress/fuzz/fuzz_sudoers.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"data/size","code":"sudoersin = fmemopen((void *)data, size, \"r\");","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are exposed as the parser input stream."},
{"step":2,"file":"plugins/sudoers/regress/fuzz/fuzz_sudoers.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":27,"var":"sudoersin","code":"init_parser(\"sudoers\", false, true);","note":"The harness starts a parser run that will consume the in-memory input."},
{"step":3,"file":"plugins/sudoers/gram.y","function":"init_parser","line":1638,"var":"parsed_policy","code":"free_parse_tree(&parsed_policy);","note":"Each parser run first frees the previous parse tree, including any tracked allocations from the prior run."},
{"step":4,"file":"plugins/sudoers/gram.y","function":"init_parser","line":1639,"var":"parser_leak_list","code":"parser_leak_init();","note":"Leak tracking is reinitialized; on the second and later calls this invokes parser_leak_free() on the existing leak list."},
{"step":5,"file":"plugins/sudoers/gram.y","function":"parser_leak_free","line":1797,"var":"entry","code":"while ((entry = SLIST_FIRST(&parser_leak_list))) {","note":"The cleanup loop walks the same leak entries that were already freed by free_parse_tree(), creating a double-free condition when the list still contains stale pointers."},
{"step":6,"file":"plugins/sudoers/gram.y","function":"parser_leak_free","line":1802,"var":"entry->u.p / entry->u.cs / entry->u.d / entry->u.m / entry->u.dig / entry->u.rc / entry->u.ptr","code":"free_privilege(priv); / free_cmndspecs(&specs); / free_defaults(&defs); / free_member(m); / free(dig->digest_str); free(dig); / free(entry->u.rc); / free(entry->u.ptr);","note":"The stale pointer is freed again through the type-specific destructor, triggering the heap-double-free sink reported by ASAN."}
]
print(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
PY > /workspace/candidate_trace.json && cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '--- submit ---' && bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/sudo/plugins/sudoers/regress/fuzz/fuzz_sudoers.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
